classification.difficultyReason: Translate clock times into standard deviations, combine empirical-rule regions and calculate an expected count using a contextual definition of lateness.

content.prompt: A train is timetabled to arrive at Central station at 8:44 am each day of the week. After 3 months the mean arrival time was 8:44 am with a standard deviation of 3 minutes. The data is normally distributed.

children.label: a
children.prompt: What percentage of times will the train arrive between 8:38 am and 8:50 am?

answer.worked: On the normal-curve sketch, 8:38 am and 8:50 am are 6 minutes either side of the mean, or $2$ standard deviations either side. By the empirical rule, approximately $95\%$ of arrival times lie in this interval.

children.label: b
children.prompt: What percentage of times will the train arrive between 8:35 am and 8:47 am?

answer.worked:
On the sketch, 8:35 am is $3$ standard deviations below the mean and 8:47 am is $1$ standard deviation above it.

$$\begin{aligned}\text{Percentage in the interval}&=2.35\%+13.5\%+34\%+34\%\\&=83.85\%.\end{aligned}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: What percentage of times will the train arrive before 8:38 am?

answer.worked:
8:38 am is $2$ standard deviations below the mean. The sketch has $95\%$ between $-2$ and $2$ standard deviations, with equal tails.

$$\text{Percentage before 8:38 am}=\frac{100\%-95\%}{2}=2.5\%.$$

children.label: d
children.prompt: What percentage of times will the train arrive after 8:47 am?

answer.worked:
8:47 am is $1$ standard deviation above the mean. The sketch has $68\%$ within $1$ standard deviation of the mean, with equal tails.

$$\text{Percentage after 8:47 am}=\frac{100\%-68\%}{2}=16\%.$$

children.label: e
children.prompt: What percentage of times will the train arrive on time or earlier?

answer.worked: The scheduled time, 8:44 am, is the mean. By symmetry of the normal curve, $50\%$ of arrival times are at or before the mean.

children.label: f
children.prompt: Sydney Trains does not classify a train as late unless it arrives 6 minutes later than the scheduled time. What percentage of times will the train arrive late?

answer.worked:
The lateness threshold is 8:50 am, which is $6\div3=2$ standard deviations above the mean. The required region is the right tail beyond this point on the sketch.

$$\text{Percentage late}=\frac{100\%-95\%}{2}=2.5\%.$$

children.label: g
children.prompt: How often will this train run late, according to Sydney Trains, in 200 days?

answer.worked:
$$\text{Expected number of late days}=200\times0.025=5.$$

The train is expected to run late on about $5$ days.

spec.description: Normal curve with raw arrival times at the mean and one, two and three standard deviations either side; empirical-rule region percentages.
spec.mathematics: Mean 8:44 am; standard deviation 3 minutes. Successive regions have percentages 0.15, 2.35, 13.5, 34, 34, 13.5, 2.35 and 0.15.
spec.answerVisibility: Answer editions only; shared by parts a–g.

sizing.exceptionReason: Complete clock times use staggered tick baselines and eight percentage labels need explicit leaders and vertical separation; retain native fonts and curve proportions.
